name: Solvability invariant
summary: Every graded result must be derivable from instruction.md plus environment/data alone.
how_it_works: Hidden seeds may choose concrete inputs but never supply a value the solver needs; an undocumented rule is a defect, not difficulty. Upstream backs it with DS-22/AL-F0e semantic gates and a visible-only solve check.
portability_note: Format-independent principle.

name: Difficulty from documented rule interaction
summary: Hardness must come from many interacting documented rules, not hidden information.
how_it_works: Idea prompt demands at least six interacting documented rules, three legal edge cases, the likely reflex implementation and its assumption inversion, exact grader observables and anti-cheat surface; finalists show a 'Six-rule interaction' field.
portability_note: Prompt text reusable as-is.

name: Complexity-lever triple with independence and isolation-breaker
summary: Each difficulty lever is (documented rule, forward transform, exact inverse); pick 2-3 independent ones, at least one stateful.
how_it_works: A lever is addable only if its inverse fits in one sentence and its rule is in the shipped spec; independence means skipping one lever fails its own tests; an isolation-breaker (running state, delta, dictionary) prevents single-example inference.
portability_note: Upstream recipe; generalise beyond binary formats.

name: Spine weighting
summary: Attach the highest-weight lever to the field most positive tests depend on.
how_it_works: Errors on the spine cascade across many tests; upstream uses this to push partial solvers down. Beta warns the opposite way (one spine can collapse reward).
portability_note: Decide stance explicitly in v2.

name: Partial-solver ceiling < 0.35
summary: Weight EASY tests 1 and HARD tests 5 and add HARD tests until easy_total/(easy_total+hard_total) < 0.35.
how_it_works: Inequality hard_total > 1.857 x easy_total; the lever is test count, not weight magnitude; loop back to add tests or a third lever if the ceiling is not met. Not adopted by beta.
portability_note: Arithmetic holds for any weighted-fraction reward; recheck if 0.24 reward formula differs.

name: Overgenerate then refine to three finalists
summary: Generate 6-10 mechanism sketches, reject reskins and hidden-info tricks, compare on fixed axes, show exactly three finalists; the user picks.
how_it_works: Comparison axes: state transitions, contract breadth, interaction depth, gradeability, asset feasibility, shortcuts, solvability. Controller enforces exactly three finalists.

name: Shared three-round refinement budget
summary: At most three refinement rounds per bundle total, successful or not, never reset across candidates or revisions.
how_it_works: Counter task.json.refinement_rounds incremented per idea review; at 3 the idea pauses and a fourth submission fails. Harden rounds are not counted by code.
portability_note: Count harden rounds in code in v2.

name: Hardening diagnosis taxonomy
summary: Separate validity defects, weak difficulty and unsupported complaints before editing.
how_it_works: Weak-difficulty patterns: free structural reward, dormant rule, answer disclosure, factorisable mainline, easy process criterion. Strengthen with legal adversarial fixtures, rule interaction, completeness, boundary ownership, reconciliation, deterministic precision, program reruns; never add volume as decoration.

name: Strict per-run model gate
summary: Every required model run individually must score test<90, rubric<90 and (test+rubric)/2<30; equality fails.
how_it_works: Decimal parsing, combined must equal the average, infrastructure must be COMPLETE, run count per model must match the policy exactly, unregistered models fail.
portability_note: Score fields come from the 0.23 report.json; thresholds hard-coded rather than read from defaults.json.

name: Oracle / nop / stub baseline
summary: Two fresh oracle runs at exactly 1.0, one nop at exactly 0.0, one hand-built shape-only stub whose every paying test is reviewed.
how_it_works: runtime_intake._solvability checks counts, rewards, infrastructure status and that paying_tests equals reviewed_tests with a rationale; upstream profile needs 5 oracle runs.
portability_note: Run roles and reward fields are harness-specific.

name: Hidden reseeded corpora and delivered-program reruns
summary: Tests run the delivered program on fresh legal inputs regenerated from published rules, from a foreign working directory.
how_it_works: Verifier regenerates eval data from a seed that lives only in the verifier image; the visible data stays spec-level.
portability_note: Also the natural place to add data volume.

name: Anti-cheat negative test suite
summary: Negative-weight tests that fire only when a cheat is present.
how_it_works: Standard four: hardcoded sample answers -5, filename-dependent behaviour -5, reads /app/data at runtime -5, nondeterministic output -3, plus task-specific negatives on the real shortcut surface; upstream QC requires at least one negative and test_negative_ naming.
portability_note: Weight scale and naming tied to 0.23 test_weights.json.

name: Structural cheat closure
summary: Agent and verifier images share nothing; reward files cannot be forged.
how_it_works: Separate verifier mode and tests/Dockerfile, EVAL_SEED only in verifier image, root-owned 0700 /logs/verifier, artifacts executed as nobody via setpriv; beta code checks environment_mode == separate at release.
portability_note: Mechanism depends on Harbor verifier model.

name: Exact deterministic comparison
summary: No tolerance APIs; compare integers, bytes and full documents exactly; publish precision and rounding stages.
how_it_works: Floats compared via IEEE bit patterns; instruction publishes ties, ordering, precision stages.

name: Contract matrix validated in both directions
summary: Every requirement has an ID, visible anchor, shapes, edge semantics, test owner and rubric owner; every promise graded and every graded predicate promised.
how_it_works: core/contracts.py validates family, >=5 constraints, reachability, duplicate observables, no state_change, conduct needs competent_routes_satisfy, profile hash. It is not reachable from the CLI.
portability_note: Wire the validator into a CLI gate in v2.

name: Rubric outcome / constraint / conduct classification
summary: Classify every criterion before judging it; conduct is valid only if every competent route satisfies it or it raises the odds of correctness.
how_it_works: Outcomes belong in tests; constraints quote one visible rule and are typed instruction following; never penalise an unstated approach; executed numeric evidence only for distinct conduct.
portability_note: Depends on whether 0.24 keeps an LLM-judged rubric channel.

name: No double payment and penalty-stacking cap
summary: The same observable must not be paid twice; one agent action may cost at most 5 across tests and rubric.
how_it_works: All-pairs observable matrix; dependency is not duplication when assertions differ; AL-30 sums negatives by triggering action.

name: Remove-the-restrictive-constraints test
summary: Mentally delete restrictive constraints; substantial outcome work must remain.
how_it_works: Prevents tasks whose difficulty is only formatting rules.

name: Deterministic performance gates
summary: Numeric performance targets only when reproducible: operation counts or stable relative ratios.
how_it_works: Upstream performance template builds its own baseline, warms up, takes medians and requires max(opt/base) <= 0.70.

name: Independent oracle with shared-bug fixture
summary: Oracle built from the written contract, not verifier code, with hand-computed fixtures including one that exposes a plausible shared bug.
how_it_works: Upstream O1 fails at >=35% shared substantive lines between solve.py and test_output.py, warns at >=20%.

name: Defect budget: focal, drift, trap
summary: TRUTH lists >=2 focal defects, >=1 drift (expert instinct contradicts spec) and >=1 trap (invisible on happy path), each naming the test it defeats.
how_it_works: Upstream format spec; beta only asks for pitfalls in TRUTH.

name: Trigger depth for every rule
summary: Each stated rule and each precedence or tie chain needs a graded fixture that comes out differently if the rule is broken.
how_it_works: Upstream AL-29.

name: Archetype anti-monotony selection
summary: Choose among 8 archetypes randomly within a per-category affinity list, with a selection RNG independent of content RNG.
how_it_works: Prevents one re-skinned archetype from dominating a batch.
portability_note: Upstream generator code not in snapshot.

name: Observed-score difficulty bands
summary: Declared difficulty must match the band of pooled observed scores; >87.5 fails.
how_it_works: Bands expert 0-25, hard 25-37.5, medium 37.5-50, easy 50-87.5; per run test% exactly 0 or 100 fails; rubric 100 rationed per arm.
portability_note: Runs as upstream output QC; trajectory layout is harness-specific.

name: Red-team hack trial and trial crux analysis
summary: Run an adversarial agent whose charter is to bypass the verifier; analyse each trial for difficulty crux, near miss and reward hacking.
how_it_works: Upstream frontier-bench prompts; beta never uses them.
portability_note: Unused gap; strong candidate for v2.

name: Mechanism cards
summary: Evidence-linked records of a visible rule, its trigger, the wrong interpretation and the root cause, with counterexamples.
how_it_works: Fingerprint = sha256 of the four text fields; evidence status VERIFIED/STALE/UNVERIFIED rechecked against file hashes and QC receipts.
portability_note: Not consumed; fingerprint incompatible with idea fingerprints (see B-027).

name: Novelty: mechanism variant vs family variant
summary: Candidates must state closest matches and behavioural differences; reskins are not novel.
how_it_works: Candidate schema requires non-empty differences; novelty recorded UNVERIFIED; catalogue intersection compares free-text tags with sha256 card fingerprints, so it never matches.
portability_note: Fix fingerprint scheme in v2.

name: Offline mutation measures grader sensitivity only
summary: Mutants and ablations show whether tests detect faults, not how a model will score.
how_it_works: Prevents claiming hardness from offline checks.

name: Repair difficulty-risk choice
summary: QC repairs that are likely easier, likely harder or unknown need an explicit user choice: fix alone, harden separately or leave unresolved.
how_it_works: difficulty_impact is a four-value enum in the analysis; the selection reanalysis rejects missing choices; harden-separately paths limited to analysed dependent files.
portability_note: Add test-count and weight regression checks.

name: Manual ChatGPT copy/paste loop
summary: Controller emits a prompt, the user pastes it into ChatGPT, the raw reply comes back as data.
how_it_works: Raw responses are preserved verbatim in idea.json; no API key needed; pasted text has no authority.

name: 19-field candidate schema
summary: Each candidate returns a fixed field list covering mechanism, rules, edge cases, observables, anti-cheat, oracle, assets, nearest pattern, solvability and risk.
how_it_works: Prompt A field list; candidate count 8.

name: Targeted refinement prompt
summary: Revise one candidate: quote the weak part, state its graded consequence, request one concrete change, preserve strong parts, return an acceptance check.
how_it_works: Prompt B, with revision_delta, expected_graded_effect, new_or_changed_contract_rules, acceptance_check, remaining_risks.

name: Finalist payload with explicit differences
summary: Show exactly three finalists with core work, mechanism, six-rule interaction, channel plans, solvability plan, risks and difference from the other two; mark none preferred.
how_it_works: Prompt C; ends with USER CHOICE REQUIRED and rounds consumed.

name: Eight-axis idea critique
summary: Check each candidate for family, real mechanism, visible contract, deterministic grading, substance without constraints, channel ownership, assets/licence/bytes, hard-but-solvable interactions.
how_it_works: Playbook checklist.

name: Strict review envelope
summary: Idea reviews use exact key sets; accepted reviews need all issues resolved and verified hash-bound evidence.
how_it_works: Family may not change; reviewer assurance must be ADVISORY_REVIEW; acceptance is advisory only. A trivial JSON file can satisfy the evidence requirement.
portability_note: Strengthen evidence semantics.

name: Record rejected ideas and nearest matches
summary: Keep rejected ideas so they are not later presented as novel.
how_it_works: Prose only; controller stores only the three finalists.
portability_note: Implement as a store in v2.

name: Pinned content-addressed QC snapshot
summary: Upstream QC is copied into the repo, digested, and the digest is re-checked before every run; mismatch yields a BLOCKED receipt.
how_it_works: snapshot_digest hashes relative name, size and content; config/source_components.json holds the pin. Digests were taken on CRLF bytes and fail on LF checkouts.
portability_note: Normalise line endings or add .gitattributes.

name: Checker execution hygiene
summary: Each checker runs as a subprocess with a timeout; inconsistent exit codes, stderr, malformed output, checker mutation or bundle mutation block the verdict.
how_it_works: 120 s per script, cwd = script dir, tree hash before/after bundle.

name: Hash-bound receipts with staleness chain
summary: Every result is a receipt bound to subject, checker, snapshot and parent receipts; any changed byte drops it.
how_it_works: receipt_id = sha256 of canonical JSON; current only if subject hash, integrity, dependencies and log hashes all match.

name: Scoped waivers and PASS WITH EXCEPTIONS
summary: Only WARN or MINOR findings may be waived, per checker+rule+scope, with approver, evidence and source version; raw results are never rewritten.
how_it_works: Waivers are separate receipts applied at read time.

name: Semantic review schema
summary: LLM or human review must cover every checklist ID from the pinned guides plus one ID per test and per rubric criterion, with file-hash anchors.
how_it_works: Schema refuses to build without test/weight bijection; reviewer context must match exactly; SKIP counts as pass.
portability_note: IDs depend on QC guide text.

name: Report-first QC repair triage
summary: Classify every report section as Real, False positive or Vague without running QC.
how_it_works: Quote must be an exact substring of the report, anchors must match current bytes, false positives cannot authorise edits, vague needs a question, every section covered once.

name: Repair authorization chain
summary: Narrow natural-language selection, separate reanalysis with path scopes and dependency closure, then a hash-bound authorization.
how_it_works: Grammar accepts only a few forms; allowed paths must be within analysed dependent files; generator paths blocked; closure may not silently add findings.

name: Post-repair verification
summary: Real non-empty diff inside scope, test/weight bijection, derived README/TRUTH counts, mechanical QC on the case-pinned producer, complete semantic review.
how_it_works: New blocking rules become new Vague findings requiring fresh selection.
portability_note: Bijection check must follow the 0.24 test layout.

name: Three-strike pause per finding
summary: Three unsuccessful attempts on the same finding pause the case before a fourth automatic edit.
how_it_works: Counter per Q id resets on success; continue keeps counters.
portability_note: Counter keyed on quoted text can be reset by rewording.

name: Local overlay policy separate from upstream
summary: Local caps and waivers live in a separate overlay file that never edits upstream rules.
how_it_works: qc/policy/beta.json declares caps, waivers, step-10 counts; code does not read it and hard-codes equivalents; the 100-test cap misses rule A3.
portability_note: Make code read the overlay.

name: Upstream QC threshold catalogue
summary: Upstream rules: tests 10 min / warn >35, rubric 8 min / warn >35, >=3 instruction-following criteria, O1 overlap 35/20%, file <=100 MiB, description <=100 words.
how_it_works: Read from pinned scripts.
portability_note: Values follow the PL QC version, which changes often.

name: Harbor report ingestion with rubric equality
summary: Run reports are imported as receipts; the graded rubric must match the bundle rubric.
how_it_works: test/rubric/combined mapped from report.json fields; subject hash must equal bundle tree hash; evidence must be inside the workspace.
portability_note: Field names are 0.23 report.json.

name: Policy matrix must equal approved settings
summary: A run matrix can be registered only if it equals the settings value; null means NOT_EVALUATED.
how_it_works: Prevents ad hoc lowering of required runs.

name: Evidence status vocabulary
summary: PASS, FAIL, WARN, NOT_RUN, BLOCKED, STALE, INCONCLUSIVE; missing or errored evidence is never PASS.
how_it_works: Readiness requires all four gates PASS or PASS WITH EXCEPTIONS.

name: Feedback five-way classification
summary: Classify complaints as bundle defect, legitimate difficulty, infrastructure, supported false positive or insufficient evidence; recurrence needs numerator and denominator.
how_it_works: Feedback stored verbatim; independent review findings checked against hashed evidence.

name: Benchmark stratification
summary: Compare mechanisms with scores only across comparable runs; dedupe same-run copies; PL acceptance is metadata.
how_it_works: Prose; code only inventories and asks for missing comparison fields.

name: Licensed asset intake with byte budget
summary: Assets need an SPDX or LicenseRef licence plus an evidence file; a per-task ledger enforces a 1 GB cumulative budget with reservations and quarantine.
how_it_works: declaration_only vs permission_verified assurance; budget read from settings.
portability_note: Connect assets to bundle files in v2.

name: Safe archive extraction and SSRF guard
summary: Zip/tar members cannot escape or link; expanded size capped; downloads reject private networks and URL credentials, also on redirects.
how_it_works: Streaming with reservation limit, 3 retries on 5xx.

name: Data necessity rule
summary: Every data file must support a graded case, cross-check or disambiguation; no answers, secrets or pure decoys.
how_it_works: Prose; pushes toward minimal data.
portability_note: Keep, but pair with explicit volume targets to fix small data.

name: Rich inputs where the agent chooses
summary: Ship a broad set of relevant reference files; the instruction need not list inputs.
how_it_works: Upstream IN-5 allows unlisted inputs; decoys still forbidden.
portability_note: Lever for larger, more varied data.

name: Nested trees as one zip input
summary: Source trees ship as a single .zip under flat environment/data.
how_it_works: Upstream archetype.toml source_archives; counts as one input.
portability_note: Depends on whether 0.24 allows nested data.

name: Exact bundle layout check
summary: Release requires exact file sets at root, environment, solution and tests, flat non-empty data, environment_mode separate and no doc leaks.
how_it_works: package_contracts.validate_input_package.
portability_note: 0.23 file layout; reuse only the exact-set technique.

name: task.toml 1.1 schema rules
summary: Exact table and key order, schema_version 1.1, absolute artifacts, environment_mode separate, authors table.
how_it_works: Upstream structure_qc T1-T16.
portability_note: Harbor 0.23 task format.

name: Weight scale and test/weight bijection
summary: Legal weights 1,3,5,-1,-3,-5 with an exact map between test functions and weight keys.
how_it_works: Upstream W1-W6 and beta repair AST check.
portability_note: Keep bijection idea; scale depends on 0.24 grading.

name: Task-only README and TRUTH generated last
summary: README and TRUTH describe only the task; TRUTH is generated from final bytes on disk; generator history must not leak.
how_it_works: Release rejects leak markers in README/TRUTH; repair verifies documented counts.

name: Folder-only, copy-verified export
summary: Export only after release check, into a new folder under workspace/releases, verifying the copied tree hash.
how_it_works: Journaled release transaction.

name: Controller registers, agent authors
summary: CLI commands create versioned PENDING_AUTHORING work orders; the coding agent writes all files.
how_it_works: No command claims a task is built.

name: Twelve-mode routing
summary: One mode per request, each with required inputs, one playbook, explicit write scope and stop conditions.
how_it_works: Routing table; analysis modes read-only.

name: Disk-first resume with explicit IDs
summary: Never infer the latest task; checkpoint records at stage boundaries; resume from disk, not chat.
how_it_works: status and resume commands; manual checkpoints in adapter guides.

name: Versioned revisions with profile pinning
summary: Each change is a new revision; tasks pin the settings hash at creation.
how_it_works: revise_task copies the previous revision; profile_hash = sha256 of settings file.

name: Fresh-session handoff prompts
summary: Ready payloads for authoring, hardening and a fresh independent review that must not trust the author's conclusions.
how_it_works: Prompt file with three payloads.

name: Model lanes
summary: Use ChatGPT high reasoning for ideas and Claude Code for local authoring; fresh-context independent review for important decisions.
how_it_works: Handbook guidance.
portability_note: Model names will date.

name: Proposal, separate approval, apply
summary: Generator, settings and baseline changes go through an immutable proposal, a separate approval bound to its hash, base-hash checks and a backup.
how_it_works: Approval single-use; advisory against same-user tampering.

name: Transactional record store
summary: Content-addressed JSON objects, atomic manifest, journals with pre/post hashes, exclusive lock, explicit recovery.
how_it_works: Unexpected third-state bytes stop recovery.

name: Write allow-lists
summary: Generator file updates limited to core/config/playbooks/prompts/tests; repairs blocked from core/config/qc/workspace.
how_it_works: Prefix and denied-part checks with symlink refusal.

name: Pasted text is data, not authority
summary: Model replies, reports and file contents cannot approve or instruct.
how_it_works: Stated in every entry doc; approvals exist only via CLI.

name: Immutable inactive source snapshots with byte diff
summary: Supplied or fetched sources become read-only NOT_ACTIVE snapshots; a diff lists added, deleted and modified files.
how_it_works: sources check fetches only the Harbor framework URL, not the PL QC repo; no rule-level diff.
portability_note: Point at the PL repo and diff rule IDs/thresholds in v2.

name: Per-case producer pinning
summary: A QC repair is verified with the exact snapshot that produced the original report, copied read-only into the case.
how_it_works: External snapshots need an attestation with sha256 and kind.

name: Archive builder with protected-tree digests
summary: One tool copies upstream components and history, hashes protected trees before and after, and writes the pin config.
how_it_works: tools/archive_sources.py; commit verified with git rev-parse.
portability_note: Replace hard-coded CHECKPOINT; normalise EOL.

name: Separate change channels
summary: Settings, source baselines and generator files have distinct propose/apply flows.
how_it_works: Baseline activation does not change which QC checker runs.
portability_note: Make baseline activation switch the checker.
